items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 24 October 2026 at 5:50pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

There is a storm warning in operation.


##Synopsis##

A very deep Atlantic low (Storm Boelo) currently tracks eastwards to the west of Scotland.


##Wind##

West 7 to severe gale 9, increasing gale 8 to storm 10, then decreasing 6 to gale 8 later.


##State of Sea##

Rough or very rough.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 6 to gale 8, becoming southwest 4 or 5. Then becoming southeast 5 to 7 later, then south or southwest 7 to gale 8 later.


##State of Sea##

Rough, becoming slight or moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor later.
